evaluation_grid.price_basis: Original S013 HFQ_RESEARCH, same executable1% LimitBuyHold and approved daily/T+1 execution; no added cash dividend attribution

protocol.parameter_design: Caller original design;32 points,total domain-normalized Euclidean radius.05,seed13; never redefine domains or replace failed points

cost_provenance.verified_within_S013: research/S013/experiments/EX008_20261010/src/declare.py: cost_scenarios stress_20bp_per_side .002; SelfCheckProtocol selects that scenario; standard .001 in common.py request_for
cost_provenance.interpretation: Retain approved2x fee factor only, not historical auxiliary3x; root controls whether latest reusable center pressure evidence exists or at most two new center pressure accounts are authorized and counted separately

five_items.parameters: max(0,center netCAGR-point netCAGR Q10),max(0,point fullDD Q90-center fullDD); all32 authentic PARAMETERS derivation bindings, full standard context. Also report absolute Q10/Q90 and original-four-goal point rates externally; no new qualification veto
five_items.time: Paired126-session strategy minus same-window executable benchmark cumulative return,Q10,step21; reuse center account, no account replay per window
five_items.concentration: Top ceil(.1*positive actual closed-cycle count) net-profit sum / all positive closed-cycle net-profit sum. No winners => NOT_APPLICABLE
five_items.execution: standard center netCAGR minus unchanged-center .002 pressure netCAGR; negative values retained; no parameter-fee or time-fee cross
five_items.uncertainty: PublicSE research-assessment-v3 paired stationary bootstrap CAGR excess95% interval,2000 replicates,mean block20,seed13. PBO/DSR only from explicitly supplied comparable family; absence is INSUFFICIENT_DATA, not zero

independent_economics.account: Actual fills fee=price*quantity*one_way_cost; cash/quantity accumulated in actual session order; no overselling; daily cash+quantity*close equals equity; all open/closed cash flows reconcile final profit
independent_economics.closed: True closed cycles must match zero terminal cycle position exactly,actual last fill equals exit date; unclosed positions excluded from frequency
independent_economics.annual: Natural-year continuous returns,openingEquity=prior year closingEquity; first year initial cash. Every year's DD includes that opening wealth
independent_economics.original_formula: netCAGR >=1.5*benchmarkCAGR if benchmarkCAGR>0 else netCAGR>0; each annualDD strictly<benchmark annualDD; actual closed*60/sessions>=4; benchmark negative years strategy annualreturn>0
independent_economics.limit: No claim to independently audit limit-fill policy, causal signal logic or historical publication times

selection: Only C8880 baseline and at most1 preferred final original-four-goal-qualified new center receive full five-item review; all newly original-four-qualified centers keep stage3 eligibility regardless of diagnostics. Helper never selects centers or excludes other qualified candidates
limitations: Repeated S013 development-pool mechanism/parameter selection is not fully corrected; annual or bootstrap diagnostics are not sealed validation

Bootstrap interval is not future return assurance or strategy success probability
No new hard gates, mandatory32/32 cutoff or replacement for original economic goals
